checkedAlternates.risk: NSAIDs like ibuprofen have mild antiplatelet effects.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Ibuprofen and naproxen are classified as analgesic/anti-inflammatory drugs (group-3), not therapeutic anticoagulants (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Insulin is injected subcutaneously like heparin.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Insulin is a glucose-regulating peptide hormone (group-1), not a blood-clotting anticoagulant (group-2).
